Exam Date & Time: 09-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  FUNDAMENTAL OF BLOCKCHAIN TECHNOLOGY [IT-4422]  
Marks: 50                                                                         Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Imagine a newly launched public blockchain network has rapidly gained popularity,  
  but due to its small number of mining participants, one group of miners manages to  
  gain control of more than 51% of the network's total hashing power. Apply your     (5)  
  A)      understanding of blockchain architecture and consensus mechanisms to explain how  
  this situation could lead to a 51% attack.  
  
  B)      Apply your knowledge of blockchain architecture to explain the role of the Genesis  
  Block in initializing a blockchain network. And how would the Genesis Block be  
  configured, and what considerations are essential for its secure and efficient        (5)  
  initialization?  
  
2)           A multi logistics company is facing issues with data inconsistency and lack of  
  transparency across its global supply chain partners. As a technology consultant, how  
  would you apply Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) to resolve these issues?          (5)  
  A)      Explain how DLT can improve data integrity, traceability, and trust among  
  stakeholders.  
  
  B)      Apply the concept of Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) to design a privacy-preserving  
  authentication system. Explain how ZKPs ensure user data confidentiality while   (5)  
  maintaining verification accuracy.  
  
3)           A global supply chain company is implementing smart contracts to automate  
  payments between suppliers and distributors. The contract automatically executes  
  payment when goods are received and verified through IoT sensors. Explain how         (5)  
  A)      smart contracts can help to reduce fraud and inefficiencies in the supply chain?  
  
  B)      A hospital network wants to use smart contracts to securely share patient medical  
  records between authorized doctors, insurance companies, and research institutions.  
  Patients have control over who can access their data. Apply the concept of oracles to (5)  
  explain their role in integrating external health data into smart contract systems.  
  
4)           Imagine you are building a decentralized content-sharing platform that avoids  
  reliance on centralized servers. As a blockchain developer, how would you leverage  
  the key technologies of the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) to design a scalable    (5)  
  A)      and secure system for storing and retrieving large media files?  
  
  B)      Apply your understanding of NFTs to analyse real-world use cases such as digital art,  
  gaming assets, music rights.                                                          (5)  
  
5)           A decentralized finance (DeFi) startup is exploring platforms to integrate a          (5)  
  decentralized prediction market into its ecosystem. The team is considering using

Augur to allow users to bet on the outcomes of events ranging from elections to  
  A)          sports and crypto prices. Analyze the Augur's key features to build a trustless and  
  efficient prediction market?  
  
  B)          You plan to introduce a custom token based on Ethereum. This token will be used  
  within the app for rewarding contributions, unlocking premium features, and  
  promoting posts.                                                                      (5)  
  Based on the scenario, Analyze the key characteristics of application coins to design  
  an effective token economy within your platform?  
  
  
-----End-----
